::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/permissions"}
#docs
`members_only` permissions are for signed-in team members; an API key never holds them. `key_resources` lists the resources an API key map may name.

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data.key` | `string` | The permission's key. |
| `data.resource` | `string` | The permission's resource. |
| `data.mode` | `string` | The permission's mode. One of `read`, `write`. |
| `data.area` | `string` | The permission's area. |
| `data.label` | `string` | The permission's label. |
| `data.members_only` | `boolean` | The permission's members only. |
| `key_resources` | `array of string` | The permission's key resources. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/permissions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
```json [200 OK]
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "permission",
      "key": "invoices:void",
      "resource": "invoices",
      "mode": "read",
      "area": "Area",
      "label": "Example"
    }
  ],
  "key_resources": [
    "Key resource"
  ]
}
```
::
